hits.title: NetBrain names new CEO with Blackstone backing over the line - NetBrain
hits.snippet: Jan 22, 2026 Network operations (NetOps) solutions provider NetBrain Technologies appointed Bernadette Nixon as its new CEO, following an investment by Blackstone. Nixon joins the firm from AI search startup Algolia, where she led the company through global expansion. NetBrain said her experience will be “instrumental as AI becomes increasingly central to modern network operations and automation.” NetBrain founder Lingping Gao will transition from the CEO role to chair of the board, having steered the ship for more than two decades. Alongside the executive reshuffle, ex-Casa Systems CEO Jerry Guo and IRIS Software Group chairman Gus Malezis joined NetBrain’s board. “NetBrain is redefining how enterprises run their networks using AI and automation to help prevent outages, strengthen resilience, and improve security,” Nixon noted in a statement. “\[Gao’s] passion and innovation have made NetBrain a category leader in network automation, and I look forward to working with our exceptional team to build on this strong foundation.” Founded in 2004, NetBrain offers no-code and AI tools to support network automation.
